observations.observation: Pale compact left title and time on chartreuse widening beam remain the two primary foci. The projector/light/bridge/audience scene is recognizable at thumbnail.
All ten required entries can be read in the displayed 720x405 view. Four practical entries are now visibly larger, approximately 16–18 px glyph height; their two-column groups have clearer word gaps.
Time/date/venue have slightly reduced extent compared with repair-1, and practical entry/preparation/capacity/weather are larger and clear of audience heads and beam boundary.

Title uses two heavy square lines at a word boundary; English and descriptor are single lines. Hangul counters, consonant/vowel connections and interword gaps are visible. Time has two-dot colons and a horizontal range bar; middle dots are visible in descriptor/capacity.

Cropped projector at left connects through a single continuous widening chartreuse plane to the far-right screen. Coral bridge planes and local halftone stay near upper crop. Five seated adult viewers remain grounded on mats.

observations.observation: Speaker holds a microphone near mouth in one connected hand/forearm; other hand gestures independently. Screen has a left edge post, top/bottom frame edges and grounded stand feet.

selection_rationale.reason: Repair-2 retains the title-to-time hierarchy, stronger flat planes and information-bearing beam from repair-1, while giving the practical facts more useful size. The remaining screen crop is explicitly retained as a limitation.
